name: phosphatidylinositol-4,5-bisphosphate 3-kinase catalytic subunit beta

function.text: PIK3CB encodes phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate 3-kinase catalytic subunit beta isoform. Annotated molecular activities include 1-phosphatidylinositol-3-kinase activity and 1-phosphatidylinositol-4,5-bisphosphate 3-kinase activity. It participates in signal transduction and phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction.
